snippet.title: Evercore Heroes: Ascension | Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Our new demo is now LIVE - add the demo to your Steam library and play today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2794270/Evercore_Heroes_Ascension_Demo/

Evercore Heroes: Ascension is a 3-player Team Action Roguelite with a focus on co-op, set in the magical sci-fantasy world of Lumerea! 

Unlock new heroes, create the best build possible and learn as you face the toughest creatures out there, as a team!

Wishlist today if you like what you see and want to support the game, thank you!

Follow us via:
Twitter:   / evercoreheroes
